notes.title: 0.46 Demo patch notes
notes.notes:
Demo 0.46 release patch notes

Includes:

* Improved readability of the Twist symbol by masking the tail on the opposite side.

notes.title: 0.45 Demo patch notes
notes.notes:
0.45 Demo patch notes:

Added anti-aliasing settings to graphics sub-menu.

Fixed bug where mouse cursor was appearing on the wrong window after leaving pause menu.

If graphics settings are not applied when leaving the graphics sub-menu they are reset.

Disabled window resizing.

Fixed bug where window size was not appearing on selected resolutions when game was running in a window.

notes.title: 0.44 Demo patch notes
notes.notes:
0.44 Demo patch notes:


     Removed hidden press M to show mouse cursor feature.
     Mouse cursor appears when you move mouse and hides when player moves.
     Bug fix: When you're holding the undo button, it stops undoing when you undo a reset. 
     If player presses space before movement has finished, puzzle in/out transition will occur if on a transition tile.
     Update play testers list in demo credits.
